subject: Two-wave virtual loop: candidate orbit, panel sequencing & debrief runbook
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Evan Cho <evan.cho@gmail.com>, Greenfield Recruiting <talent@greenfieldrecruit.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Two-wave virtual loop: candidate orbit, panel sequencing & debrief runbook

Hi Evan / Greenfield team —

We're excited to move forward with a two-wave virtual onsite for the Staff Engineer role. Below is a proposed structure so you can confirm availability; I attached a compact itinerary and the panel-role roster.

Wave A (focus: system design + leadership): 60m system design (Laura), 30m leadership behavioral (Marissa), 15m break/overlap buffer.
Wave B (focus: deep technical + product pairing): 45m coding/architecture deep dive (Camila), 30m cross-functional pairing (product), 15m debrief handoff.

Total expected time on camera: ~3 hours with a 30–45 minute async debrief window for interviewers. We try to keep the candidate-facing blocks contiguous and reserve a short async debrief template to capture rubrics quickly.

Proposed dates/times (PDT):
- Wed 23 Jun, 9:00–12:00 (two-wave back-to-back)
- Thu 24 Jun, 13:00–16:00 (alternate slot)

Can you confirm Evan's availability for either option and any timezone constraints? If neither works, list three windows and we'll tile.

Attachments: two-wave-itinerary.pdf (PDF), panel-roles.csv (CSV), debrief-template.md (Markdown)

Thanks — I want to lock panel sequencing and share calendar invites by EOD tomorrow.

Best,

Camila Reyes
Senior Recruiter, Talent Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Evan Cho <evan.cho@gmail.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenfield Recruiting <talent@greenfieldrecruit.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Two-wave virtual loop: candidate orbit, panel sequencing & debrief runbook

Thanks Camila — appreciate the clear breakdown. Wed 23 Jun at 9:00 PDT works best for me. Thu is blocked, but I can do late Friday morning if something changes.

A couple of notes: I prefer the longer design block early in the day; low bandwidth in the afternoon for me. Also happy to get short pre-read materials if helpful (design docs, API sketches).

Cheers,
Evan

Laura / Marissa — Evan confirmed Wed 23 Jun 9:00 PDT (he prefers heavy design early). I updated the itinerary to push the 60m system design to the 9:00 slot and moved behavioral to immediately after with a short buffer. Please review the internal notes below — aim to keep scoring to the new rubric and use the async debrief template for rapid capture.

Internal runbook highlights (for interviewers only):
- Confirm camera/audio 10m before start.
- 9:00–10:00: System design (Laura) — focus on scaling short-lived batch workers and KV-store tradeoffs. See pre-read link in calendar.
- 10:15–10:45: Leadership/behavioral (Marissa) — use STAR + cross-team influence lens.
- 10:45–11:00: Buffer / candidate break.
- 11:00–11:45: Deep technical follow-up (Camila) — architecture + code-level reasoning.

Debrief cadence: each interviewer fills debrief-template.md within 20 minutes. If divergence is >2 points on overall, schedule 15m sync with all interviewers. I added a short checklist for red flags in the document.

Can you both confirm you have access to the panel-roles CSV and the debrief template? If anything needs swapping (product vs. engineering pairing), tell me ASAP — I can loop in Logan if we need a product interviewer.

Thanks — I will send calendar invites to Evan and Greenfield once you confirm.

Camila

---
Camila Reyes

Got it — I see the updated panel-roles.csv and I have access to debrief-template.md. Confirming I'll lead the 9–10 system design and will seed two probing prompts focused on fault-tolerance and cost tradeoffs.

One ask: can you drop the pre-read (1–2 pgs) into the calendar invite so Evan can glance before the session? That will let me use the full 60 minutes for problem solving rather than onboarding the context.

If product pairing changes, ping Logan; otherwise I'm set.

Laura Bennett
Staff Engineer, Platform
Redwood Inference
